VRCForge Windows release builds may bundle the official uv Windows x64
runtime binaries for backend-managed support tooling on machines without a
system Python or uv installation.

Upstream project: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0

VRCForge does not modify the uv binaries. Support-tool caches and managed
Python directories stay under the user's VRCForge data folder. The uv runtime
does not install, start, or transport the project-scoped VRCForge MCP Core.
